test_title: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper (Held On: 12th September 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A car starts from point P on a circular track and an SUV starts from point Q, which is 600 meters ahead of P in the direction of motion. The car's speed is 15 m/s, and the SUV's speed is 10 m/s. The circumference of the track is 1.5 km. How much distance will the car have traveled when it first overtakes the SUV?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial separation gap between **Car** and **SUV** = 600 m.

**Relative Speed** = 15 − 10 = 5 m/s.

Time taken to overtake = 600 ÷ 5 = 120 s.

**Distance** traveled by the car = 15 m/s × 120 s = 1800 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 1800 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Car (vC) = 15 m/s

Speed of SUV (vS) = 10 m/s

Initial gap (d) = 600 m

Circumference of track = 1.5 km = 1500 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42871ea5f6b074bdda0c49cf026df460f552ccc8cc15bec98a98c3fc44195b2d.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time (t) = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Relative Speed** = vC − vS

⇒ Relative Speed = 15 − 10 = 5 m/s

⇒ **Time** to cover the 600 m gap (t) = 600 ÷ 5

⇒ t = 120 seconds

⇒ **Total Distance** covered by the car = vC × t

⇒ Distance = 15 × 120 = 1800 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1800 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, the effective speed is the **difference** of their individual speeds: Vᵣₑₗ = V₁ − V₂.

Circular Track Catching Up

On a circular track, the first overtake occurs when the faster object covers the **initial separation distance** plus any additional laps relative to the slower object. Time = (Initial Gap) ÷ (Relative Speed).

Successive Meetings

For objects starting from the same point, the first meeting occurs after time T = Circumference ÷ (V₁ − V₂) for same direction, or T = Circumference ÷ (V₁ + V₂) for opposite direction.</p
